titel: LPA England and Wales – transfer list

texte: The OPG offers a free online service that creates the form for you.
Address: https://www.lastingpowerofattorney.service.gov.uk

This filling-in aid prepares: it keeps your answers in one place so that you can transfer them into the OPG online service or into the paper form LP1F or LP1H. It does not replace the service or the form.
This list is not a form and not an official document. It is not submitted anywhere.
The sections follow the order of the official form. Section titles and field labels are given word for word as on the form.
Dates are shown as year-month-day; the form asks for day, month, year.

abschnitte.titel: Section 8 · Your legal rights and responsibilities

texte: This section has no fields. Everyone who signs reads it on the official form.
Signing, witnessing and certifying happen on the printed form. Vivodepot does not do these steps.
Sections 9, 10 and 11 were signed in order. Section 9 must have been signed first, then section 10, then section 11.
Sign this page (and any continuation sheets) before anyone signs sections 10 and 11.
Sign this page and section 5 (and any continuation sheets) before anyone signs sections 10 and 11.
Only sign this section after the donor has signed section 9
A certificate provider can’t be one of the attorneys.
Only sign this section after the certificate provider has signed section 10
All the attorneys and replacement attorneys need to sign.
Registration is with the Office of the Public Guardian. Vivodepot does not submit anything.
Before the LPA can be used, it must be registered by the Office of the Public Guardian (OPG).
If there are any ‘people to notify’ listed in section 6, you must notify them that you are registering the LPA now.
Fill in and send each of them a copy of the form to notify people – LP3.

Fee according to gov.uk (https://www.gov.uk/power-of-attorney, retrieved 18 October 2026):
Applying to register an LPA costs £92 unless you get a reduction or exemption.
